card.name: Grade or type numbers after 'or'
card.fires_on: The digit in a severity grade or diabetes type, mostly the 4 in 'Grade 3 or 4' just before an adverse event term. It also fires on type 1 or 2 diabetes.

modes.label: Grade 3 or 4
modes.description: The second number in a toxicity grade range, right before a reaction name.
modes.example: Grade 3 or <<4>> renal failure or impairment.

modes.label: Diabetes type number
modes.description: The digit after 'type' in type 1 or type 2 diabetes mellitus.
modes.example: Recommended Starting Dosage in Patients with Type <<2>> Diabetes Mellitus
